commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' A corner kick by Qatar is thwarted by the well prepared Nikola Vasilj (Bosnia & Herzegovina).

90+4' A nice pass finds Pedro Miguel (Qatar) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the top of the net, but Nikola Vasilj pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him. The ball goes out for a corner. Qatar can continue in their attacking effort.
90+3' Flag goes up against Akram Afif (Qatar) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' Ahmed Al Ganehi (Qatar) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The Qatar players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
86' Ahmed Al Ganehi (Qatar) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar.
86' Dennis Hadzikadunic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jesus Valenzuela blows for a foul.
82' Ermin Mahmic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
82' The game has come to an end for Kerim Alajbegovic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Dzenis Burnic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
80' 3 - 1 Goal! Ermin Mahmic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:1.
80' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) works the corner short.

80' Mahmoud Abunada makes a brilliant save! Esmir Bajraktarevic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper! The ball goes out of play and Bosnia & Herzegovina have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Julen Lopetegui prepares a substitution. Ahmed Fathi is replaced by Mohammad Al Mannai (Qatar).
79' Substitution. Edmilson Junior will be replaced by Ahmed Alaaeldin (Qatar).
78' What was Ahmed Fathi (Qatar) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
77' Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
76' Edmilson Junior (Qatar) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Karim Boudiaf trots off the pitch and is replaced by Almoez Ali (Qatar).
71' The attendance is 66925.
69' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
68' The corner from Akram Afif (Qatar) is cleared away by the defence.
68' Karim Boudiaf (Qatar) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Qatar win a corner.
67' It will be a corner kick for Qatar.
67' The ball is cleared after Akram Afif (Qatar) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
66' Ivan Basic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
64' Nikola Vasilj (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is able to continue to play.
64' Sergej Barbarez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ermin Mahmic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) replacing Edin Dzeko.
63' That will be all from Nikola Katic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Dennis Hadzikadunic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
62' Nikola Vasilj (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sultan Al Brake (Qatar).
60' Akram Afif (Qatar) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
59' Sead Kolasinac (Bosnia & Herzegovina) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
57' Akram Afif (Qatar) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
56' Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar) is substituted due to injury. Julen Lopetegui gives a chance to Ahmed Al Ganehi.
55' Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
54' Pedro Miguel (Qatar) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
53' The ball possession is 59:41.
51' Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Edin Dzeko.
50' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mahmoud Abunada intercepts the ball.
47' Sead Kolasinac (Bosnia & Herzegovina) sends a cross into the box, but Mahmoud Abunada comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' Julen Lopetegui has made a change at the break. Abdulaziz Hatem has come on in place of Jassem Gaber (Qatar).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Arjan Malic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) comes off for Amar Memic.
46' Half-time substitution. Ivan Sunjic is replaced by Benjamin Tahirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
46' Referee Jesus Valenzuela blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Sultan Al Brake (Qatar) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45+3' Pedro Miguel (Qatar) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Boualem Khoukhi (Qatar) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
44' The corner from Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is intercepted by the defence.

44' Sead Kolasinac (Bosnia & Herzegovina) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Bosnia & Herzegovina will take a corner.
42' 2 - 1 Goal! Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar) scores after an assist by Edmilson Junior that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:1.
40' Sultan Al Brake (Qatar) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Hasan Al Haydos, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
39' What a chance that is! Edin Dzeko (Bosnia & Herzegovina) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the right post!
38' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
37' Arjan Malic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
34' 2 - 0 An own goal! Mahmoud Abunada (Qatar) had a great deal of bad luck. He wanted to intercept a dangerous pass, but he hit it in badly and sent it past his goalkeeper.
33' The resulting corner from Ivan Basic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

33' Ivan Basic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Bosnia & Herzegovina are awarded a corner kick.
32' Arjan Malic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

29' 1 - 0 Goal! Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top right corner. Mahmoud Abunada had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.

28' Nikola Katic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
27' Jassem Gaber (Qatar) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jesus Valenzuela stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
23' A cooling break is underway.
23' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
22' Jesus Valenzuela couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jassem Gaber (Qatar) and blew his whistle. Bosnia & Herzegovina are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
21' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
20' Akram Afif (Qatar) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
19' Ivan Basic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
18' Bosnia & Herzegovina are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. Bosnia & Herzegovina get a corner.
17' Ivan Basic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
16' Jassem Gaber (Qatar) commits a foul and Jesus Valenzuela immediately signals a free kick.
13' Akram Afif (Qatar) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bosnia & Herzegovina, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' Edmilson Junior (Qatar) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
10' Jesus Valenzuela blows his whistle for a foul after Arjan Malic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) hacks down one of his opponents.
8' Akram Afif (Qatar) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
8' Akram Afif (Qatar) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Qatar.
5' Akram Afif (Qatar) tries to find Edmilson Junior, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
4' Ivan Basic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

3' A neat pass is well received by Ivan Sunjic (Bosnia & Herzegovina), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bosnia & Herzegovina.
2' Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Mahmoud Abunada easily deals with the threat.
2' A cross from Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bosnia & Herzegovina will have the kick-off.
Jesus Valenzuela was nominated as the referee for this game.
